question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        AVG(composition / NULLIF(index_value, 0)) AS avg_composition_ratio
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018','10-2018','11-2018','12-2018','01-2019','02-2019','03-2019','04-2019','05-2019','06-2019','07-2019','08-2019')
      AND interest_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition_ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_interests AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, avg_composition_ratio AS max_index_composition
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, max_index_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(month_year, 4, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) AS month_num
    FROM top_interests
),
with_lags AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        max_index_composition,
        month_num,
        ROUND(AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY month_num ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 4) AS rolling_avg_3month,
        LAG(interest_id, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS prev1_interest_id,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS prev1_max_composition,
        LAG(interest_id, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS prev2_interest_id,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS prev2_max_composition
    FROM ordered
)
SELECT 
    wl.month_year AS date,
    im.interest_name,
    wl.max_index_composition,
    wl.rolling_avg_3month,
    prev_im.interest_name AS prev1_interest_name,
    wl.prev1_max_composition AS prev1_max_composition,
    prev2_im.interest_name AS prev2_interest_name,
    wl.prev2_max_composition AS prev2_max_composition
FROM with_lags wl
LEFT JOIN interest_map im ON wl.interest_id = im.id
LEFT JOIN interest_map prev_im ON wl.prev1_interest_id = prev_im.id
LEFT JOIN interest_map prev2_im ON wl.prev2_interest_id = prev2_im.id
ORDER BY wl.month_num
